title: VoiceOver may find a link in the rotor but be unable to open it
acceptance: With VoiceOver on, a link found via the Links rotor opens when double-tapped
If it does not, the fix keeps ordinary taps routing through the app's own handler
notes: Flagged honestly by T-0051 rather than assumed. To stop UIKit's own link interaction double-opening a link, it returns nil from textView(_:primaryActionFor:defaultAction:). That guarantees ordinary taps still route through the app's gesture recogniser. What is unknown is whether VoiceOver's synthetic activation on a rotor-found link goes through that same recogniser or dead-ends on the declined default action. A link a VoiceOver user can find but cannot open is worse than one they cannot find. Needs a device — see docs/DEVICE-CHECKS.md item 4.
